description: Parameters consumed by the installer build stage. Vendor overrides may suppress, replace, or extend these via a vendor-scripts/07-installer.params.json in the config repo.

parameterGroups.name: Stage Selections
parameterGroups.description: Boolean flags that control which pipeline stages are enabled. All stage-gate parameters are collected here so operators can see and adjust the full execution plan in one place.

parameters.name: ENABLE_INSTALLERS
parameters.description: Build platform-specific installer packages (.msi on Windows, .pkg on macOS, .deb/.rpm on Linux). Enabled by default. Set to false for archive-only builds that do not require installer packages.
